translations: Mary said that she was offended.

usageExamples: Mary era circondata dalle sue amiche.
Mary was surrounded by her friends.
A volte Mary lo fa e a volte non lo fa.
Sometimes Mary does that and sometimes she doesn't.
Mary sa che cosa vuole dire.
Mary knows what she wants to say.
Mary mi disse che non aveva fame.
Mary told me that she wasn't hungry.
Tom disse che era divertito.
Tom said that he was amused.
Tom disse che era brava.
Tom said that you were good.
Sembra che sia seria.
She looks like she's serious.
È quello che sono.
It's what I am.
Sapeva che doveva farlo.
She knew she had to do that.
Tom era creativo.
Tom was creative.
Chi era qua?
Who was here?
Chiese se era invitata.
She asked if she was invited.
